ThingDef.label: Air strike Targeter
ThingDef.description: A device that requests firepower support from EDF attack aircraft. A single rocket is fired at a designated point. The request time is short and easy to use. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: EDF Tactical fire support request device
ThingDef.description: A communications device that transmits the point of attack to EDF tactical bombers. The request is automatically accepted, and within minutes, the attack force rushes to the site for immediate bombing. It is a special attack plan to eliminate particularly important targets, and most opponents will be overrun by the overwhelming firepower. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: Zero laser rifle
ThingDef.description: A powerful, high-energy laser weapon capable of continuous irradiation. When the energy laser strikes an object, it causes an annihilation reaction that destroys the object. It is an extremely powerful weapon, but it is produced in small numbers and is only equipped in small quantities by the elite "Omega Team. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: Blazer
ThingDef.description: Mass-production model of the atomic ray gun "Blazer" developed based on the ultra-large atomic ray gun "EMC". The prototype was said to have about 10% to 15% of the output of the EMC, but the mass-produced model is somewhat less powerful. Even so, it is still powerful enough to vaporize objects in an instant.It is now being deployed in large numbers as the next standard equipment for EDF infantry. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: AF99ST
ThingDef.description: The last model of ST model. With a power and penetrating capability beyond that of an assault rifle, it became an intense firearm that could strike at any opponent. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: AF-100
ThingDef.description: The ultimate and most powerful assault rifle. Even alien technology has been incorporated to achieve a significant improvement in performance. While it is an assault rifle, it has the same power as a medium caliber cannon, and if handled properly, it has the power to break through the war situation. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: TZ Stork
ThingDef.description: The ultimate and most powerful stoke assault rifle, which was finally completed by fully introducing innovative technology and even applying alien technology. It is truly a trump card to defeat invading organisms. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: X500-Orchid
ThingDef.description: An improved version of X400 Orchid. Its stability has been increased, and its performance has become more suitable as the final operational model. Although it is inferior to the standard series in terms of rapid-fire capability, it is more effective against heavily armored targets due to its high penetrating power. It is truly a trump card to defeat invading organisms. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: MA9 Slade
ThingDef.description: A large assault rifle newly developed for elite units. Its performance is powerful and unmatched in a word, and it is said to be able to conquer a battlefield even with a single rider if carried by an experienced soldier. It is truly a trump card to defeat invading organisms. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: LysanderZ
ThingDef.description: Lysander of the final battle specifications. It incorporates electromagnetic acceleration in its firing mechanism, and has tremendous power that exceeds that of the F-type. It is an extremely powerful weapon, but because of its incredibly complex internal structure, only a few of them are deployed per division. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: Hercules
ThingDef.description: Sniper rifle with the highest versatility. It is as powerful as a tank gun, yet can fire a certain amount of rapid fire, and is said to be able to get through most battlefields with just one of these rifles. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: KFF70
ThingDef.description: This is the final battle specification of the KFF series. It is a masterpiece that meets the highest standards of performance required of a sniper rifle.A small number of them are deployed in the elite sniper units of the EDF. It is equipped with a self-destruct function to prevent capture.

ThingDef.label: Mini ShotGun
ThingDef.description: Revolvercannon is a large-calibre machine gun developed by the EDF as a large robot-carrying weapon. It has good power and rate of fire and can fight to advantage even with large enemy robots, which are the virtual enemy.

ThingDef.label: RevolverCannon
ThingDef.description: Revolvercannon is a large-calibre machine gun developed by the EDF as a large robot-carrying weapon. It has good power and rate of fire and can fight to advantage even with large enemy robots, which are the virtual enemy.

ThingDef.label: Nix Machinegun
ThingDef.description: Large caliber machine gun designed to fit large exoskeleton suits. It can disperse bullets at a high rate and is very easy to handle. Although it has a small caliber compared to vehicle-mounted guns, it is much more powerful than infantry firearms.

ThingDef.label: RevolverCannon
ThingDef.description: Revolvercannon is a large-calibre machine gun developed by the EDF as a large robot-carrying weapon.It's designed for anti-infantry and anti-armored vehicles, but it's also effective against giant bugs and aliens.

ThingDef.label: Nix Machinegun
ThingDef.description: Final operation version of the Nix machine gun. It can unleash a more dense and powerful barrage.

ThingDef.label: Particle machine gun
ThingDef.description: A powerful machine gun that fires charged particles. It has a high rate of fire and excellent suppression capability, so a frontal firefight is not a good idea.

ThingDef.label: Spark launcher
ThingDef.description: Short-range plasma launcher. It fires a burst of exploding plasma spheres to attack a wide area.

ThingDef.label: Plasma Cannon
ThingDef.description: Long-range plasma launcher. A nasty weapon with high power and long range, suitable for blowing up a position.

ThingDef.label: Particle Gatling gun
ThingDef.description: A Gatling gun that fires a barrage of charged particles at high speed. It is an extremely powerful weapon, and standing in front of it with half-equipment means death.

ThingDef.label: Particle Stream Cannon
ThingDef.description: Long-range, high-velocity plasma launcher. It has high power, long range, and high bullet velocity, making it extremely dangerous when targeted.
